reserves.issuerOrObligor: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund (BVI)

reserveReview.reviewer: PoR verification sweep 2026-08 (live-adapter alignment: curated rows carry the usdtb-transparency adapter's slice identities - BUIDL and assets-in-motion - so V9 can classify live rows; the Deloitte June 30 examination remains the assurance artefact on proofOfReserves.latestReport)

sources.label: USDtb Reserve Report - June 2026 (Deloitte via Anchorage)

reserveReview.rationale: Curated rows mirror the live usdtb-transparency adapter's slice identities (BUIDL held at the published Anchorage custody address, plus the USD assets-in-motion settlement float the endpoint reports). The Deloitte June 30, 2026 examination (read directly this pass: $777.2M reserves vs $775.1M redeemable USDtb - $766.9M BUIDL at fair value, $10.2M FDIC-insured demand deposits) is recorded on the proofOfReserves latestReport and corroborates the ~98.7% BUIDL concentration; the float's banking counterparty and settlement timing remain undisclosed. compositionAsOf is intentionally absent: the live endpoint is a rolling basis, not the examined balance-sheet date.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The assets-in-motion USD settlement float has no disclosed banking counterparty or settlement timing.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The issuer reports this amount as USD assets in motion but does not identify its banking counterparty or settlement timeline.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Anchorage reports that BUIDL is self-custodied in segregated wallets and cash is held in segregated fiduciary trust accounts at major commercial banks. The banks are not identified, current provider allocations can change, and the legal treatment has not been independently adjudicated.
